SurveyConfig.title: SurveyConfig
SurveyConfig.description: Configuration and live visibility state for an individual survey or pedagogical case.

surveyId.description: Unique identifier of the survey or pedagogical case.

isOpen.description: Whether participants are currently allowed to submit responses.

showLiveResults.description: Whether live results are visible on the projector screen before closing.

showCorrectAnswer.description: Whether the correct answer or sequence is revealed.

activeRound.description: Active voting round counter incremented upon admin reset.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last configuration update.

adminSessionId.description: Verified admin session ID authorizing configuration updates.

SurveyResponse.title: SurveyResponse
SurveyResponse.description: An individual participant response to a survey or pedagogical case.

surveyId.description: Identifier of the survey or case.

round.description: Voting round number matching the survey activeRound.

selectedOptions.description: Single selected option ID for the survey or pedagogical case.

sequence.description: Reserved empty array for backward schema compatibility.

language.description: Interface language active when the response was submitted.

submittedAt.description: Server timestamp when the response was recorded.

CouncilSettings.title: CouncilSettings
CouncilSettings.description: Global council settings including freshman feedback video configuration and voting rules.

videoUrl.description: URL of the pre-recorded freshman feedback video.

videoTitle.description: Optional display title for the video.

preventDuplicateVotes.description: Whether one vote per session per survey round is enforced.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

adminSessionId.description: Verified admin session ID authorizing settings update.

passwordHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the administrator password.

adminSessionId.description: Verified admin session ID authorizing password update.

AdminSession.title: AdminSession
AdminSession.description: Verified administrator session token created after password hash verification.

passwordHash.description: Submitted SHA-256 password digest verified against AdminConfig.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was established.

/surveys/{surveyId}.description: Configuration and status documents for each of the 4 council polls and cases.

/surveys/{surveyId}/responses/{responseI.description: Subcollection storing immutable participant submissions per survey/case.

/admin_config/{configId}.description: Server-side unreadable administrator password hash document ('auth').
